# Arch Linux package

This directory is generated by the Linux packaging profile and contains the
versioned JSoftSIP application archive, its PKGBUILD, and desktop entry.

Build and install with:

```bash
makepkg -si
```

The package uses the bundled JLink runtime (it does not install a system Java)
and depends on Baresip being available. Removing the package with `pacman -R`
does not remove per-user settings under `~/.config/jsoftsip` or
`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/jsoftsip`.
